title: ModelDocViewStyle DetailViewStyle group-2 numeric insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize changed DetailViewStyle boundary-line color and weight when absent from a captured raw source group.
Preserve style-group ordering, aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders, and exact raw-carrier comparison.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied DetailViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 62 (boundary-line color) and group 90 (boundary-line weight) within an existing group-2 style block when the typed values differ from class defaults and no source group represented them. Numeric color range is checked before insertion. ASCII raw lexemes are updated in lockstep; Binary raw-value placeholders remain aligned.
implementation.generatedControl: The secondary DetailViewStyle omits group-2 color and weight values while retaining the group marker/resource reference. The test changes values to 42 and 37, verifies the full expected ordered raw group stream and typed ASCII/Binary readback.

commands.command: git diff --check -- dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

limitations: Only same-version DXF typed-field serialization is covered for these two generated numeric properties.
Other absent numeric/handle fields and changed repeated-field cardinality remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
